description: Source code for a script that handles internationalization (i18n) processing of documentation files, including translation jobs, parallel processing, and file filtering.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing translation process, parsing flags, managing worker goroutines, and orchestrating documentation translation workflows.

methods.name: runDocSequential
methods.description: Processes a list of documentation files sequentially, handling translations and logging progress.

methods.name: runDocParallel
methods.description: Processes documentation files in parallel using multiple goroutines with channels, managing job distribution and result collection.

methods.name: runSegmentSequential
methods.description: Processes a list of files sequentially for segment-based translation, typically translating smaller sections within files.

methods.name: resolveRelPath
methods.description: Resolves the relative path of a file with respect to the documentation root.

methods.name: filterDocQueue
methods.description: Filters files to skip those already translated and unchanged, based on hashing and existing output checks.
